senses.gloss: m. (preced.) a pronged tool, mattock (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Raster).
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 7b:24">Ib.</cite> <he>ד׳ נעוץ וכ׳</he> the mattock was stuck into the ground on the eve of the Festival.
Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ יחפור בדֶקֶל (twice).—Pl. דְּקָרִים, דְּקָרִין. מֵי ד׳ apurgative water, v. דָּקַר a. דֶּקֶל.
<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:6">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> (differences about spelling <he>דקר׳</he> or <he>דקל׳</he>); Y. ib. XIV, 14ᶜ; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:7">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כמין ד׳</he> like prongs, v. <cite ref="D00339"><he>דּוֹקְרָן</he></cite>.
